logline: 傳聞追不到江邊。遠山還在，心卻輕了。
youtubeTitle: [playlist] QuietLY · 秋江遠望 — Slow Mandarin Jazz for Seeing Through the World

comics.en: Reed wind softens the city behind you.
A sail too small to carry an argument.
Sit until the sunset lowers itself.
comics.zh: 坐下，直到夕陽自己變矮。

comics.en: One lamp is enough to keep the night honest.

tracks.lyrics:
[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
城裡的舊傳聞
像風穿過巷口
誰贏過誰
誰又被說成笑話

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]
舊話很輕
江風更輕
傳到這裡
只剩蘆葦點頭

[Verse 2]
我把那些名字放下
走到江邊更高的地方
傳聞追不到石坪
只有水聲替我改題

[Poetry]
滾滾長江東逝水
浪花淘盡英雄
是非成敗轉頭空
青山依舊在
幾度夕陽紅

[English — after poetry]
Old rumours thin out at the river
No need to answer every name
Let the wind keep what is useless
And leave me the quiet bank

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
世情若是說書
我就把最後一頁翻慢
慢到能聽見
自己不生氣

[Final chorus]
傳聞散了
江還在流
我把笑聲
還給遠山

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[English — opening]
Praise and blame both ask for my attention
I give it to the river instead
Neither wave owns the bank
And neither owns me

[Instrumental — 10 seconds]

[Verse 1]
有人誇你一句
有人貶你一句
兩種聲音
都想把你留在原地

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]
褒是一陣潮
貶是一陣潮
岸不搬家
人就穩一點

[Verse 2]
我聽過太多次
終於聽成江水
誇也不熱
貶也不冷

[Poetry]
是非成敗轉頭空

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
如果褒貶是考試
我選擇交白卷
把筆
還給黃昏

[Final chorus]
潮退之後
泥還是泥
我還是我
剛剛好

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
匆忙的腳步
趕著下一場證明
鞋底很響
心卻越來越薄

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]
慢下來
路才出現
夕陽變矮
也不催我

[Verse 2]
我放慢到
能聽見自己的呼吸
江風一寸寸過來
替匆忙道歉

[English — before poetry]
Before the old line arrives
put the hurry down
The path is clearer
when the feet stop arguing

[Poetry]
幾度夕陽紅

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
趕得再快
也趕不過東逝水
停一下
才看見自己還在

[Final chorus]
腳步輕了
證明遠了
人反而
完整一點

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Both] 宴席散得很乾淨
杯盞還記得溫度
[Female] 祝詞還在空氣裡
[Male] 人卻一個個離開

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]
空桌像鏡子
照出熱鬧多短
笑談比誓言

[English — between choruses]

[Chorus — return]
空桌像鏡子
照出熱鬧多短

[Verse 2]
我們對看一眼

[Poetry]

都付笑談中

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]
乾杯的回聲
最後只剩江聲
空也是一種
誠實的收場

[Final chorus]
燈滅了
江還亮一點
我們把客套
留在桌上

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
名片上的名

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]
名只是字

[Verse 2]
頭銜像一件外套
天氣一變就不合身
江邊沒有人查驗

浪花淘盡英雄

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — English nested]
Names on cards fade faster than water
I keep my hands free
No title needed

[Final chorus]
字淡了

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
蘆葦風很軟

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[English — after Verse 1]

Carriage noise thins out
I keep what is soft

[Instrumental — 10 seconds]

[Chorus]

硬話落地
蘆葦彎一彎
又不折斷

[Verse 2]

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Bridge — almost spoken]

[Instrumental coda — 40 seconds, gradual fade, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
遠帆很小

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]

[Verse 2]
有人追船

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Instrumental intro — 35 seconds, no vocal]

[Verse 1]
[Female] 石坪微涼
[Male] 剛好能坐
[Both] 江在下面做事

[Instrumental interlude — 20 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

[Chorus]

浪花淘盡英雄

[English — before poetry]

not every splash

白髮漁樵江渚上

[Instrumental break — 25 seconds, no vocal]

青山依舊在
